high_level_description: This image captures a dramatic volcanic eruption at night. The volcano is actively spewing lava and ash into the sky, creating a striking contrast against the dark backdrop of the night sky. The lava flows down the slopes of the volcano, glowing with an intense red-orange hue, while the ash and smoke rise high into the air, forming a dense plume that billows upwards. The sky is filled with lightning bolts, adding to the intensity and drama of the scene. The lightning strikes appear to be emanating from the volcano itself, suggesting a powerful electrical discharge triggered by the eruption.
